name: seaweedfs/seaweedfs
title: seaweedfs/seaweedfs
summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.
